mapper.select: SELECT B.ID AS bindingRefId, R.ID AS roleRefId, R.ROLE_ID AS roleId, R.ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, R.ROLE_NAME AS roleName, B.SCOPE_TYPE AS scopeType, P.ID AS permissionRefId, P.PERMISSION_ID AS permissionId, P.PERMISSION_CODE AS permissionCode, P.RESOURCE_TYPE AS resourceType, UI.ID AS uiRefId, UI.MENU_CODE AS menuCode, UI.MENU_NAME AS menuName, UI.MENU_ICON AS menuIcon, UI.ROUTER_CODE AS routerCode, UI.ROUTER_URL AS routerUrl, UI.FILE_PATH AS filePath FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M ON M.ID = B.MEMBER_REF_ID AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND M.USER_REF_ID = #{userRefId} AND M.VERSION = #{memberVersion} AND M.AUTH_VERSION = #{authVersion} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND A.TENANT_ID = T.TENANT_ID AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.AUTH_YEAR = B.AUTH_YEAR AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID)) LEFT JOIN PEACH_SAAS_UI_RESOURCE UI ON UI.PERMISSION_REF_ID = P.ID AND P.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'MENU' AND UI.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND UI.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE B.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND B.MEMBER_REF_ID = #{memberRefId} AND B.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND B.AUTH_YEAR = #{year} AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0 ORDER BY R.ID, P.ID, B.ID LIMIT 1025
